programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Country Doctor
programmes.d: A country doctor refuses to slow down and seems to be working himself to death.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Time in a Bottle
programmes.d: A district attorney clashes with a lawyer who agrees to defend a friend charged with stealing.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Back to Oakland
programmes.d: Mark returns to Oakland to become a police officer again, and is reunited with his old partner. However, he discovers his old beat has become a storm of racial hatred.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: We Have Forever - Part 1
programmes.d: Jonathan hopes that he'll be released from his duties to be reunited with his former wife when she passes away.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: We Have Forever - Part 2
programmes.d: Jonathan hopes that he'll be released from his duties to be reunited with his former wife when she passes away.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Correspondent
programmes.d: A war correspondent finds himself imprisoned and facing execution. Meanwhile, Jonathan and Mark show him what's he's missed during his life by putting work ahead of family.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Aloha
programmes.d: A Hawaiian singer learns to overcome self-pity after being disabled in a truck accident.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Dolphin Song for Lee - Part 1
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark help a teenage cancer patient named Lee who wants to save the dolphins.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven
programmes.d: Lee's cancer is now in remission. She gets back to work on her save-the-dolphins campaign.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Heaven Nose, Mister Smith
programmes.d: Jonathan must stop an angel who's back on Earth with the intention of breaking up his son's marriage.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Whole Nine Yards
programmes.d: A chauvinistic coach doesn't want a female wide receiver on his junior-high football team.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Whose Trash Is It Anyway?
programmes.d: Mark's friend is running for public office, and he's a very honest man. But things get out of hand when an opponent tries to win by going after his son.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Hello and Farewell - Part 1
programmes.d: Jonathan helps Commander Michaels to deal with flashbacks of Vietnam; he also tries to convince her to go to therapy. Mark deals with his fear of flying.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Silent Bell
programmes.d: A pastor must follow a church council's decision to fire most of the staff at the school because they're not Christian.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Reunion
programmes.d: Mark attends his high school class reunion and learns that some memories are bittersweet for his old friends.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Source
programmes.d: A teenage girl tells school reporters that a driver came on to her right before the bus got into an accident. She may not be telling the truth. Jonathan tries to teach the news writers the correct way to report a story.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven
programmes.d: The problems of the handicapped are addressed when an amputee joins a crusade after a false fire alarm.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Goodbye, Mr. Zelinka
programmes.d: Mr. Zelinka is a beloved teacher who is being forced to retire because he's old. Jonathan and Mark know that he would prefer to continue teaching.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Choices
programmes.d: The parents of two Vietnamese children come to America to look for them after a ten-year separation.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Summer Camp
programmes.d: After having been scarred in a fire, an actress becomes a counselor at a summer camp for blind children. The camp is run by Jonathan and Mark's blind friend Frank.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Inner Limits
programmes.d: A young man decides to institutionalize his brother who has been completely paralyzed and speechless for many years, against the wishes of their mother.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: It's a Dog's Life
programmes.d: Mark believes that God has turned Jonathan into a dog. Meanwhile, he must contend with a runaway kid and the kid's scatterbrained mother.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Merry Christmas from Grandpa
programmes.d: On Christmas Eve, Jonathan shows three men what will happen in the future if the Earth continues to be ravaged by pollution. One of the men is an energy official another is a farmer and the third one is the President.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Pilot - Part 1
programmes.d: In the series opener, we meet Jonathan Smith, a probationary angel who has been sent to help people on Earth. He befriends residents at a retirement home. The administrator at the home has a brother named Mark who is suspicious of Jonathan.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Pilot - Part 2
programmes.d: Jonathan helps the residents of Havencrest, when they learn that the retirement home is going to be sold. Jonathan must reveal his real identity to Mark in order to complete the assignment.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: To Touch The Moon
programmes.d: Jonathan helps a terminally ill boy and his mother. Meanwhile, Mark deals with a thief abandoned by his folks.
